verdicts.reason: A keeps the large slanted 'Buy 1 piece / Get 1 free' as the clear focal point with the subhead above it. However, the underline rule has moved above 'Shop the deal' and is shifted right (about x 230–566), so it no longer lines up with the centred CTA, and the CTA ends up jammed near the bottom edge. B shrinks the headline until it is barely bigger than the subhead and smaller than the 'Shop the deal' CTA, which flips the hierarchy. It also leaves a large dead gap in the middle of the canvas, and its rule is still offset to the right of the CTA text.
